outcome: Make the in-memory adapter settle its reservation the way the real one does, so a test that reads a handful of times does not exhaust a day's budget and a passing test means the same thing on both adapters.
non_goals: Do not raise the budget to make the symptom go away
Do not stop reserving before the work
Do not let the two adapters disagree about what a reservation costs

transitions.reason: the cursor work measured that a read transaction reserves a worst case of six thousand and one reads and the in-memory adapter never settles it, while the real adapter counts what it actually read and trues the reservation up. The consequence is that only four read transactions fit in a day on the in-memory adapter, so a seven-page walk had to advance an injected clock by a day between pages to run at all. A budget that binds at four reads on one adapter and not the other means a green test on the fast adapter is not evidence about the slow one
